newsitem.title: UK: M & S shares ease slightly after results.
newsitem.headline: M & S shares ease slightly after results.

text.p: Shares in Marks & Spencer eased one pence to 508-1/2 after the clothing and retail group announced full-year profit which largely met market forecasts.
"They are pretty much in line with expectations," one dealer said.
Marks & Spencer reported full-year pre-tax profit rose 10.9 percent to 1.1 billion stg compared with market forecasts ranging from 1.1 to 1.3 billion stg.
Profit margins in Britain were maintained despite "very competitive" trading conditions, Marks & Spencer said.
The new financial year has started in line with our expectations, the company added.
